title: Emergency and governor's rule imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
detail: Reports dated Oct 11 say the president approved the federal cabinet's recommendation to impose an emergency and governor's rule in KP under Articles 232 and 234, ending Sohail Afridi's tenure as chief minister, with Governor Faisal Karim Kundi as administrator. Republic World reports mobile data was throttled in selected urban areas and that Afridi was reportedly taken into custody per a KP minister's claim; PTI says detained leaders were moved to undisclosed locations. Details come mostly from non-Pakistani outlets and remain unconfirmed by official Pakistani statements found in search.

media.caption: Pakistan imposes emergency, governor's rule in PTI-led KP
